baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic future verb at word 1 directly governs ٱلْجَحِيمَ at word 2.
baseline_models.mechanism: Eye-or-insight perception is coupled to a materially blazing object, so the line promises not abstract information but an unavoidable encounter in which severe heat becomes perceptually present.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight supplies the act of perception and makes encounter, rather than hearsay, the governing mechanism.
Blazing fire, piled embers, and severe heat supply the perceived object and give the encounter material force.

changed_reading.before: You will come to know that Jahim exists.
changed_reading.after: You will be brought into actual perceptual contact with a blaze whose intensity cannot remain conceptual.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: لَتَرَوُنَّ can activate reflective judgment as well as ocular sight, while ٱلْجَحِيمَ carries an image of conflict at lethal intensity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The seeing verb can function as inward appraisal, and the object can carry the pressure of battle or death at full blaze. The line therefore also reads as a compelled verdict: deliberation is driven to acknowledge a reality at crisis intensity.

activation_trace.role: Opinion, knowledge, and considered judgment supply an inward mode of seeing and function as the verse's verdict-forming process.
Battle or death at a blaze supplies crisis intensity and functions as the pressure under which judgment can no longer remain undecided.

changed_reading.before: The line predicts a spectacle.
changed_reading.after: The line also predicts the collapse of evasive opinion into a compelled, crisis-level recognition.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus joins a branch of mutual visibility in ر ء ي to a branch in which ج ح م itself images a glowing, sharply staring eye.
baseline_models.mechanism: The object of sight is not inert: mutual visibility and the eye-like blaze create a two-way visual field. Seeing Jahim can therefore mean entering range of something that seems to look back, converting spectatorship into confrontation.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility and facing supply a reciprocal visual relation and function to place seer and seen within one exposed field.
The glowing or staring eye supplies an ocular image inside the object and functions as the returned gaze.

changed_reading.before: The audience safely observes an external object.
changed_reading.after: The audience crosses into reciprocal visual range, where the blaze confronts and exposes its viewers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The emphatic future construction around لَتَرَوُنَّ can activate the showing-and-making-seen branch even though the surface verb names the audience's seeing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The assurance of future sight backgrounds voluntary looking and foregrounds disclosure: the blazing object will be put beyond concealment. The latent causative image turns the line from a forecast of looking into a promise that reality will be displayed.

activation_trace.role: Showing and making seen supply forced disclosure and function as the hidden causative pressure of the emphatic prediction.
The blazing fire supplies what is disclosed and functions as the reality that can no longer be screened from view.

changed_reading.before: The audience may eventually happen to look at Jahim.
changed_reading.after: Jahim will be actively brought out of concealment for the audience; avoidance of the display is excluded.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The split mapping for the focus root ر ء ي preserves a non-dominant ر و ي branch of quenching beside the explicit blazing-heat object.
baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant water image sits against severe fire: the promised encounter becomes an anti-quenching scene in which the phonological neighborhood of satisfaction is reversed into exposure to heat. This is a contrastive activation, not a replacement gloss for لَتَرَوُنَّ.

activation_trace.role: Quenching and freedom from thirst supply a latent water expectation and function as the inverse material state against which the blaze is felt.
Blazing fire and severe heat supply the explicit material pole and function to reverse the latent expectation of quenching.

changed_reading.before: Seeing is a neutral channel by which the object becomes known.
changed_reading.after: The sound-root split lets seeing register as a failed promise of relief: the encounter gives heat where a distant lexical echo offers quenching.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus inventories allow the seeing verb to evoke acting for spectators and the object root to evoke a loss of shame.
baseline_models.mechanism: A social rather than merely optical reading appears: visibility sought as performance is reversed into visibility suffered as exposure. The line can carry the latent irony that those organized around being seen will themselves face a shamelessly exposing object.

activation_trace.role: Showing off before people supplies performative visibility and functions as the social gaze that the focus later reverses.
Little shame or modesty supplies unshielded exposure and functions as the loss of social cover before the seen reality.

changed_reading.before: The line concerns private perception of punishment.
changed_reading.after: The line also contains a social reversal from managing how one is seen to undergoing an exposure from which shame offers no screen.

context_deltas.mechanism: Distraction transfers attention from one object to another, while competitive increase continually renews the substitute object. Against that capture, the focus sight becomes a forced return of attention: the blaze is what the multiplying contest kept out of frame and what the emphatic future makes impossible to exclude.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight seeing supplies recovered perception and functions as the seizure of an attention that had been redirected.
The severe blaze supplies the excluded object and functions as the reality that finally monopolizes the visual field.
Being occupied away from one thing by another supplies attentional substitution and functions as the mechanism of prior non-seeing.
Outdoing others by number supplies a self-renewing competitive target and functions as the engine that keeps attention captured.

structural_cues: 102:1 and 102:6 address the same plural audience; the earlier clause assigns distraction to competitive increase, while the later emphatic verb assigns that audience an unavoidable object of sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distraction-by-substitution and numerical rivalry; I infer that captured attention delays and therefore intensifies the later perceptual seizure. Alternatively, the two clauses may contrast topics without describing one continuous attention mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse independently forecasts a terrible sight.
changed_reading.after: The verse repossesses an attention repeatedly captured by comparison: what rivalry trained the audience not to see becomes the one sight it cannot evade.

context_deltas.mechanism: One distraction branch images putting material into a mill's mouth, while increase can image matter gathering into a mass. Coupled to piled embers, these images produce a material causal model: repeated accumulation is feedstock, the consuming process is continually fed, and the focus sight reveals the furnace-like result.

activation_trace.role: Putting something into the mouth of a mill supplies repeated feeding and functions as the transfer of accumulated material into a consuming process.
Matter gathered together supplies the accumulating mass and functions as the feedstock produced by competitive increase.
Piled embers and blazing heat supply the terminal material state and function as the consuming outcome of what was fed.
Perceptual seeing supplies disclosure of the result and functions as recognition of the process's accumulated output.

structural_cues: In 102:1 competitive increase is grammatically the agent of distraction, allowing the accumulating process to act rather than remain a static possession.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mill-feeding image, gathered mass, and piled embers; I infer a feedstock-to-furnace arrow from their material sequence. Alternatively, these may be independent branch images with no intended causal continuity.

changed_reading.before: Jahim is an externally prepared scene eventually encountered.
changed_reading.after: Jahim can be read as the visible consuming outcome of a process the audience kept feeding through accumulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: Enjoyable diversion and outnumbering turn other people into spectators, rivals, and measures of worth. This supplies a social arena for the focus branches of display and lost shame: the gaze cultivated for competitive self-presentation is reversed into compulsory public exposure.

activation_trace.role: Play and enjoyment supply the attractive surface of social performance and function as the affective lure that sustains display.
Competitive outnumbering supplies rivals and comparative spectators and functions as the public metric around which display is organized.
Showing off before people supplies managed visibility and functions as the social gaze that is turned back on the audience.
Little shame supplies exposure without a modest covering and functions as the humiliating quality of the reversed gaze.

structural_cues: The same second-person plural first appears as the object captured by rivalry and later as the emphatically guaranteed subject of seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pleasurable diversion, competitive outnumbering, performative visibility, and shameless exposure; I infer that rivalry is socially staged and that the later gaze reverses its direction. Alternatively, the focus seeing verb may carry no activation from its ostentation branch.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains only a faint possibility of social exposure.
changed_reading.after: Competitive increase supplies the missing audience and motive: the verse reverses a life of being seen advantageously into being exposed before an uncontrollable sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: Visiting supplies directed but temporary arrival, while burial places the dead under cover and the grave branch adds depth or hiddenness. The focus then operates as an exposure reversal: passage into concealment is not a terminal disappearance but a threshold after which the blaze is made visible.

activation_trace.role: Visiting and purposeful approach supply temporary arrival and function as movement through, rather than permanent settlement at, the graves.
Covering the dead in a grave supplies literal concealment and functions as the screen that the later sight overturns.
Hiddenness and depression supply a spatial descent out of view and function as the low concealed phase before disclosure.
Making something seen supplies disclosure and functions as the reversal of burial's visual occlusion.
The blazing fire supplies what lies beyond the concealed interval and functions as the post-grave object brought into view.

structural_cues: The boundary particle حَتَّىٰ in 102:2 makes arrival at the graves an endpoint of the prior distraction, while the remaining sequence continues beyond that endpoint to sight.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies visitation, burial, and hidden depth; I infer that a visit is transit and that grave concealment is therefore reversible by later disclosure. Alternatively, visit may simply name arrival, without implying a temporary station.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a scene detached from burial.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the reversal of the grave's apparent finality: descent out of sight becomes passage toward an unavoidable unveiling.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first knowledge branch supplies disclosure to a knower; the repeated clause can then activate knowledge as a distinguishing mark that guides. Placed before the focus, the two declarations turn sight into the third phase of an epistemic sequence: disclosure, discriminating recognition, and finally perceptual encounter.

activation_trace.role: Something becoming disclosed to a knower supplies initial cognitive opening and functions as the first stage before vision.
A distinguishing sign that guides supplies marked recognition and functions as a second, more discriminating stage.
Reflective judgment supplies continuity between knowing and seeing and functions as the point where prior cognition becomes a settled verdict.
The blaze supplies the eventual perceptual referent and functions as the reality toward which the knowledge stages converge.

structural_cues: 102:3 and 102:4 repeat the same future-knowledge clause, with ثُمَّ inserted before the second occurrence, before 102:6 changes the governing verb from knowing to seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated future knowing plus disclosure and guiding-mark branches; I infer differentiated stages and let seeing complete their sequence. Alternatively, the repetition may be rhetorical reinforcement with no staged epistemic functions.

changed_reading.before: Sight arrives abruptly and supplies the first decisive cognition.
changed_reading.after: Sight is the embodied third stage of a process already moving through disclosure and discriminating recognition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled knowledge root and the branch of certainty as fixed knowledge immediately precede the seeing clause. This separates epistemic firmness from visual encounter: seeing Jahim need not create the truth but changes its medium, making what could be known without doubt materially present.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to the knower supplies cognition in both verb and noun and functions as the pre-visual mode of access.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies epistemic firmness and functions as the benchmark attained before ocular encounter.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the new perceptual medium and functions as embodiment of what certainty had held cognitively.
The severe blaze supplies material presence and functions as the object in which prior certainty becomes encounter.

structural_cues: 102:5 places a conditional particle before a verb-noun repetition of ع ل م and the genitive phrase عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ; 102:6 immediately switches to emphatic seeing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies knowledge doubled as verb and noun, certainty without doubt, and then seeing; I infer a change of access mode rather than first-time information. Alternatively, the conditional may mark that such knowledge was absent, leaving sight as the first actual certainty.

changed_reading.before: Seeing Jahim is how the audience first becomes certain.
changed_reading.after: The verse marks a modality shift: certainty could precede the scene, but the scene converts certainty from held knowledge into inescapable presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next verse repeats emphatic seeing, resumes Jahim with a pronoun, and adds eye-certainty. Eye-witnessing and the branch 'the thing itself' create a resolution shift: 102:6 opens the whole object-field, while 102:7 narrows that encounter into direct, exact presence.

activation_trace.role: Eye-or-insight perception supplies the first sight and functions as entry into the perceptual field.
The named blaze supplies the broad object of the first sight and functions as the scene initially opened.
Certainty with doubt removed supplies epistemic closure and functions as the quality attached to the second sight.
Repeated eye-or-insight seeing supplies renewed perception and functions as a second pass at higher immediacy.
Direct witnessing by the eye supplies evidential immediacy and functions as the resolution increase of the repeated sight.
The thing itself supplies unmediated identity and functions to collapse the remaining distance between viewer and referent.

structural_cues: 102:7 begins with ثُمَّ, repeats the emphatic future seeing form, replaces the named object with -هَا, and appends عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two emphatic sights, pronominal resumption, direct eye-witnessing, and the thing itself; I infer that the first opens a field and the second sharpens it to exact presence. Alternatively, the second may simply restate the first for emphasis.

changed_reading.before: 102:6 is one complete and terminal act of seeing.
changed_reading.after: 102:6 is the first threshold of a two-pass encounter: the blaze becomes visible there, then becomes directly and precisely present in the repeated sight.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant mapped root at the repeated seeing verb contributes narration and transmission, while ع ي ن contributes the thing itself. Their opposition creates a mediation model: the two sights terminate a world of reports, moving from what can be relayed about Jahim to the referent itself.

activation_trace.role: Perceptual seeing supplies first-hand access and functions as the focus anchor for overcoming mediation.
The blaze supplies the referent and functions as what can no longer remain an object merely described by others.
Relaying reports and poetry supplies mediated transmission and functions as the informational state that direct sight supersedes.
The thing itself supplies direct referential presence and functions as the endpoint beyond narrative mediation.

structural_cues: The same emphatic seeing verb occurs in 102:6 and 102:7, while the latter adds a phrase capable of specifying direct presence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a non-dominant narration branch and an 'itself' branch; I infer a report-to-presence transition across the repeated seeing. Alternatively, the split mapping may be lexicographic noise with no live relation to the Quranic form.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely says that a currently unseen object will later be visible.
changed_reading.after: The verse ends reliance on transmitted accounts: Jahim passes from reportable content to the directly encountered thing itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mutual visibility already lets the focus object return the gaze; the next verse adds another seeing verb and an explicit looking eye. Repetition closes the visual circuit, so the audience is not merely shown Jahim but placed under an eye-like blaze in a scene of reciprocal exposure.

activation_trace.role: Mutual visibility supplies two-way facing and functions as the relation that prevents detached spectatorship.
The glowing or staring eye supplies an ocular object and functions as the gaze returned by the blaze.
Repeated mutual facing supplies persistence of the reciprocal field and functions to close escape from the returned gaze.
The looking eye supplies explicit ocular agency and functions as reinforcement for reading the scene as exposure under a gaze.

structural_cues: The second sight follows with ثُمَّ and adds عَيْنَ, multiplying ocular language rather than moving away from it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mutual visibility, a staring-eye image, repeated seeing, and a looking eye; I infer a closed reciprocal gaze in which the object exposes its viewers. Alternatively, all ocular branches may intensify only the audience's act of looking.

changed_reading.before: The reciprocal-gaze model is possible from the focus inventories but remains isolated.
changed_reading.after: The repeated seeing and explicit eye close the circuit: Jahim is encountered as an eye-like presence before which the viewers themselves become visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus split-root quenching image is repeated in the next seeing verb and then meets ع ي ن as a flowing spring, all under fixed certainty. This builds a sustained water counter-image around the blaze: the very route that sounds capable of quenching instead delivers incontrovertible heat.

activation_trace.role: Quenching supplies the first latent water expectation and functions as the inverse material frame for seeing the blaze.
Severe heat supplies the explicit object-state and functions as the contradiction of expected relief.
Doubtless stability supplies closure and functions to prevent the water counter-image from softening the reality of the blaze.
Repeated quenching supplies a second water echo and functions to sustain rather than merely flash the inverse expectation.
A flowing spring supplies an explicit source of water and functions as the counterfactual relief placed beside certain sight.

structural_cues: 102:7 repeats the focus seeing root and immediately places it beside عَيْنَ and certainty, allowing the split-root water image to recur in a denser environment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two non-dominant quenching branches, a spring branch, fixed certainty, and the blaze; I infer a deliberate material counter-image of unavailable relief. Alternatively, the split root may be accidental mapping noise and عَيْنَ may activate only ocular sight.

changed_reading.before: The focus alone offers a brief and very distant quenching-versus-heat contrast.
changed_reading.after: The following spring image and repeated split root make the contrast systemic: the route that evokes water culminates in certain exposure to fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: Questioning introduces demand and accountability, while نعيم supplies good condition, softness, and ease. Because interrogation follows the two sights, the focus becomes evidentiary disclosure: the blaze provides the scene against which enjoyed ease can no longer remain an unexamined private state.

activation_trace.role: Making something seen supplies evidentiary disclosure and functions as the presentation of reality before questioning.
The severe blaze supplies the disclosed scene and functions as the standard against which prior ease becomes answerable.
Questioning and requesting supply a demand for response and function as the accountability procedure following sight.
Good condition and blessing supply what is examined and function as the benefited state placed under inquiry.
Softness and ease of living supply the felt texture of comfort and function as the contrast that gives the blaze forensic force.

structural_cues: 102:8 follows the repeated sight with ثُمَّ and an emphatic passive questioning construction directed at the same plural audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies disclosure, blaze, questioning, and ease; I infer that the sight functions as evidence that renders enjoyed comfort answerable. Alternatively, the sight and questioning may be successive events without an evidentiary arrow between them.

changed_reading.before: Seeing Jahim is solely punitive perception.
changed_reading.after: Seeing Jahim is also an evidentiary confrontation that changes comfort from something consumed into something for which an account is demanded.

context_deltas.mechanism: The non-dominant mapping of the questioning root contributes gentle, hidden extraction, while نعيم contributes softness and luxurious ease. Together they produce a forensic material analogy: disclosure of the blaze opens the soft surface of comfort, and questioning draws out liabilities that had slipped invisibly inside it.

activation_trace.role: Showing and making seen supply exposure and function as the opening of what comfort had kept out of view.
The blaze supplies the exposed consequence and functions as the pressure under which hidden liabilities become extractable.
Drawing something out gently and secretly supplies extraction from concealment and functions as the forensic action latent in questioning.
Softness and luxurious ease supply the covering medium and function as the surface from which concealed obligation is drawn.

structural_cues: The passive questioning form in 102:8 follows two emphatic sights, so the audience moves from being made to see to being acted upon by inquiry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a non-dominant hidden-extraction branch and a softness branch; I infer that questioning draws concealed liability out of ease after sight exposes it. Alternatively, the س ل ل mapping may be unrelated to the actual questioning form.

changed_reading.before: The focus displays a punishment, after which a separate question is asked.
changed_reading.after: The display begins an extraction process: the blaze opens comfortable appearances so inquiry can draw their hidden account into the open.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The seclusion branch of ي ق ن is far from the ordinary certainty sense, but it remains packet-backed and is anchored to the focus branch of making seen. Carry it only as a spatial analogy of guarded knowledge being unveiled, not as a lexical gloss for عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus's emphatic seeing can realize disclosure after the preceding certainty root activates an image of protection and seclusion.

activation_trace.role: Protection and seclusion supply a guarded interior and function as an exploratory spatial image for certainty held behind a screen.
Showing and making seen supply unveiling and function as the breach of the preceding guarded interior.
The blazing object supplies what appears after the screen is breached and functions as the content no longer held at protected distance.

changed_reading.before: Certainty is simply greater firmness before the sight.
changed_reading.after: Certainty can be pictured as truth held in a guarded chamber, while 102:6 is the violent unveiling that removes its protective distance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Visible pregnancy is an odd, form-distant branch activation, yet its hidden-growth-to-visible-sign mechanism is tightly anchored to the focus seeing verb and sharpened by increase and grave-hiddenness. Render it as a temporal-material analogy for matured consequence, never as reproductive content asserted by the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A focus branch of ر ء ي names hidden growth becoming visibly detectable, while ٱلْجَحِيمَ supplies the severe result that finally appears.

activation_trace.role: Increase and numerical growth supply gradual enlargement and function as the developmental process producing a later-visible outcome.
Hiddenness and depression supply an unseen interval and function as the concealment within which consequence matures.
Pregnancy becoming visibly apparent supplies the emergence of a previously hidden process and functions as the moment accumulated consequence shows.
The blazing fire supplies the matured visible outcome and functions as what the prior growth has been carrying toward disclosure.

changed_reading.before: Jahim appears later as an unrelated external destination.
changed_reading.after: Jahim becomes the visible maturation of a consequence that competitive increase grew and grave-hiddenness temporarily concealed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The mirror and flaring-face branches create a cross-domain reflexive image rather than a direct syntactic claim. It remains valid because both are focus-root branches and the next verse contributes 'the thing itself'; downstream prose should qualify Jahim as acting like a mirror of inward heat, not identify the object with a human face.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus seeing root can supply a mirror or visible facial sign, and the object root can supply a face heated by anger.

activation_trace.role: Mirror, visible appearance, and facial sign supply a reflective surface and function as the medium that returns the viewer's condition.
A face flaring with anger supplies inward heat made outwardly legible and functions as what the fiery mirror reflects.
The thing itself supplies direct identity and functions as the pressure that turns reflected appearance into self-recognition.

changed_reading.before: The audience sees a fire wholly external to itself.
changed_reading.after: The fire can operate as a mirror in which inwardly cultivated heat becomes a visible sign, making sight an act of self-recognition as well as observation.

strongest_changes: Distraction and numerical rivalry recast the focus as the forced recapture of an attention trained away from its decisive object.
The knowledge-and-certainty sequence changes seeing from first information into a shift from cognitive firmness to material presence.
The repeated sight in 102:7 turns 102:6 into the first threshold of a two-pass encounter that sharpens from named scene to the thing itself.
Visitation and grave concealment make the focus a reversal of apparent finality: what passes out of sight is subsequently disclosed.
The final questioning of ease makes the sight evidentiary, placing enjoyed comfort under an account rather than leaving punishment and pleasure as unrelated themes.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustained several coexisting mechanisms: optical encounter, compelled judgment, reciprocal gaze, forced display, social exposure, and a split-root water counter-image. Context did not collapse them; it staged knowledge before sight, sharpened sight through repetition, and activated material analogies of feedstock, concealment, extraction, and unavailable quenching.
remaining_uncertainties: The focus does not settle whether its first seeing is primarily ocular, insightful, or deliberately able to hold both.
The second sight may mark temporal succession, increased perceptual resolution, rhetorical reinforcement, or more than one of these at once.
The non-dominant ر و ي and س ل ل mappings produce coherent water, narration, and extraction models, but their form-distance requires explicit exploratory containment.
The social-display, gestation, and mirror mechanisms are well anchored to supplied branches yet remain analogical rather than ordinary lexical readings.
